item.title: One Of The Worlds Largest Manga Piracy Sites Has Been Shutdown In International Crackdown
item.description: Bato.to, one of the world's largest manga piracy sites, has been shut down along with 60 related domains after Chinese authorities detained its suspected operator. Read on for the full details.

item.title: GHOST IN THE SHELL 2026 Anime Remake Drops Stunning New Trailer
item.description: Science Saru unveils first trailer for the 2026 Ghost in the Shell anime and it is looking great. The trailer looks like this will be a very faithful adaptation of the Ghost in the Shell manga.

item.title: DEMON SLAYER: INFINITY CASTLE ARC Gets Its Most Immersive Experience Yet With SCREENX And ULTRA 4DX
item.description: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - Infinity Castle Arc Part 1 is coming to special SCREENX and ULTRA 4DX screenings later this month, giving fans the most immersive viewing experience yet!

item.title: ONE PIECE: The Straw Hats Get The Spotlight On New Season 2 Character Posters
item.description: Following the recent full trailer, Netflix has released some character posters for the second season of One Piece, spotlighting Monkey D. Luffy and his Straw Hat Pirates...

item.title: CRUNCHYROLL Raises Prices On All Tiers Starting This Month
item.description: Crunchyroll is raising the prices on all three of its paid subscription tiers in the United States, beginning today. Here are the new prices for the Fan, Mega Fan, and Ultimate Tiers.

item.title: Seattle Mariners Bring Back Fan Favorite ONE PIECE Night With Exclusive Jersey Giveaway
item.description: The Seattle Mariners host their second One Piece Night on March 31st, 2026, featuring a commemorative Mariners themed jersey, card game demos, and a matchup against the New York Yankees at T-Mobile Park.

item.title: BLUE EXORCIST Manga Is Entering A 4 Month Hiatus Status As Creator Prepares For Final Chapter
item.description: Blue Exorcist, manga by Kazue Kato goes on hiatus starting March 4th, 2026. Creator is gearing up for its final chapter, the manga should be resuming in July.

item.title: WELCOME TO DEMON SCHOOL! IRUMA-KUN Spinoff IRUMAFIA EDITION Is Getting An Anime Next Year
item.description: NHK has announced a TV anime adaptation is coming for Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun: IruMafia Edition spinoff manga, the anime is set to be premiering next year.

item.title: MY UNIQUE SKILL MAKES ME OP EVEN AT LEVEL 1 Manga Goes On Hiatus Due To Artist Health Concerns
item.description: Kodansha's Monthly Shonen Sirius announces hiatus status for My Unique Skill Makes Me OP Even at Level 1 manga series due to artist Mawata's health issues. The return date is TBA.

item.title: ROOSTER FIGHTER Anime English Dub Trailer Confirms Toonami Premiere Date
item.description: Viz Media and Adult Swim have dropped an English dub trailer for the Rooster Fighter anime. The anime is set to debut on Toonami March 14th this year.
